transcript: Be patient when you're becoming someone you've never been. Of course it's going to feel uncomfortable. You're stepping into a version of yourself that your body has no memory of. Your nervous system and subconscious only knows how to survive through old patterns. All the overthinking, the people pleasing, the shrieking yourself so no one gets upset. So when you finally start choosing you, setting boundaries, speaking your truth, your system is going to freak out. It's going to tell you that you're selfish. It's going to try to pull you back into familiar chaos. And not because you're failing, but because your body has been trained to equate comfort with suffering. That's why change feels like danger. That's why healing feels like you're losing yourself. You are not. You're simply just finally meeting the parts of you that never got to exist. So if you feel lost, confused or doubtful, that's a very good place to be. You're not going backwards. You're crossing the threshold into who you were meant to be.
